paragraphs.text:
CAIRO RAIL ST ATION
You can get a good meal here between 5am and 8pm. An 
offensive odor, like the scent of manure, hangs over the station. 
Many British soldiers prowl about here.
If you have just arrived, go to any Cairo location on the Egypt 
Location Table.
Trains to Alexandria depart at 9am, 12 noon, and 5pm. The 
trip takes one hour. On arrival, go to 195.
A noon departure for Athens takes three days to complete. 
On arrival, go to 183.
(Egypt Location)
